Alex (Sales): Quick sync / Contoso procurement asking for executed MSA + DPA (EU data residency clause) and signed order form. They want to extend POC from 30 -> 120 days. Who owns DocuSign routing for EU deals? cc @Natalie (AE)

David (Legal): They sent DPA redlines that remove our export-control clause. That's a hard no. Ask them to upload tracked-changes DOCX so I can respond.
Sam (Platform Eng): Tech: we can do eu-west VPC private deployment. SSO (SAML) onboarding ~2 business days. To reserve Dedicated for POC ops needs a PO or refundable deposit 0,000 EUR (we can discuss numbers) and we can hold up to 8 A100-equivalent GPUs.

Natalie (AE): Procurement also asked whether we can provide SLA credits during POC (they expect 99.9% or credits).
David (Legal): For trials we don't provide SLA credits. I'll propose compromise language: keep export-control section, allow customer review of subprocessors and 30-day notice for additions, and a reduced liability cap for the POC. I'll upload annotated MSA/DPA and a DOCX with tracked changes by EOD.
Alex (Sales): ops-bot gave DocuSign EU template link. Procurement sign order preferred flow: procurement@contoso.com -> legal@contoso.com -> ceo@contoso.com.
Sam (Platform Eng): Confirming reserve conditions: refundable deposit or a PO covering estimated run costs; SSO + KMS config required to satisfy EU key residency.
Alex (Sales): Action items: 1) @David draft redlines & POC liability language; 2) @Sam confirm deposit amount and GPU reservation; 3) @Natalie gather signatory emails and confirm billing entity; I'll update Contoso and ask for tracked-changes DOCX. :thumbsup:
